PreviousNativeBestB1Below60.Status: previous B1 native benchmark; robustness incomplete

InterruptedNativeAttempts.Cause: not certified; concurrent memory pressure suspected

RuntimeResourceFailures.Cause: Concurrent memory pressure is strongly indicated by exit 137 and observed memory saturation; a kernel OOM record was not available, so the exact killer is not claimed as proven.
RuntimeResourceFailures.Mitigation: Gateway concurrency reduced from two to one native financial child. After a single long-holding profile still exited137, the managed cap was raised from3GiB to5GiB and MemAvailable admission reserve from4GiB to6GiB.
RuntimeResourceFailures.CompletedRetry: V7_SELL8_H8, V7_SELL8_H16 and V7_SELL8_H24 completed under the revised single-child gateway; the four exit-137 attempts remain excluded.
